		}

country_event = {
	id = zin_aenor.300
	title = zin_aenor.300.t
	desc = {
		text = zin_aenor.300.desc
		trigger = {
			zin_aenor_ruled_by_faithful = yes
		}
	}
	desc = {
		text = zin_aenor.300.desc1
	}
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_generic_court
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { zin_aenor_ruled_by_faithful = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_character = zin_merovan }
				retire_character = zin_merovan
			}
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_aenor_throne_abandoned days = 180 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = zin_aenor_captains_regency } } zin_aenor_captains_regency = { set_nationality = PREV } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_in_play_aenor_captains_regency } } set_global_flag = zin_in_play_aenor_captains_regency add_country_leader_role = { character = zin_aenor_captains_regency country_leader = { ideology = zin_light_wardens expire = "2000.1.1.1" } } }
			promote_character = zin_aenor_captains_regency
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_stance = 3 }
			zin_politics_set_stance = yes
			set_variable = { zin_aenor_ruling_camp = 5 }
			zin_aenor_set_party_names = yes
			country_event = { id = zin_reign.86 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zin_aenor.300.a
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = zin_aenor.402
	title = zin_aenor.402.t
	desc = zin_aenor.402.desc
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_concord_council
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30

	option = {
		name = zin_aenor.402.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				add = 60
				check_variable = { zin_concord_loyalty > 39 }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 60
				any_neighbor_country = {
					zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				tag = SEL
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_subject = no }
			zin_aenor_rejoin_dominion = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_charter = 3 }
			zin_aenor_set_charter = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
			zin_aenor_add_concord_loyalty = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zin_aenor.402.b
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}
}
